selected_evidence.requirement: 100 MB filesystem-enforced storage limit for datauser under /srv/data
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the account and directory ownership, XFS quota accounting and enforcement enabled, 100 MiB soft/hard limits, and an over-limit write rejected with EDQUOT.
Shows valid persistent fstab/kernel quota configuration and the filesystem mounted with `usrquota` after activation.

Captures the healthy baseline and pre-restart boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered filesystem/account/data hash and quota state, plus successful post-restart enforcement testing and clean final state.

set -eu

command -v xfs_quota || true
command -v setquota || true
rpm -q quota quota-nls xfsprogs 2>&1 || true

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd datauser >/dev/null; then
  useradd --home-dir /srv/data --no-create-home --shell /bin/bash datauser
fi
install -d -m 0700 -o datauser -g datauser /srv/data
getent passwd datauser
stat -c 'path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /srv/data

set -eu
cp -a /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.before-datauser-quota
sed -i '/[[:space:]]\/[[:space:]]\+xfs[[:space:]]/ s/[[:space:]]defaults[[:space:]]/ defaults,uquota /' /etc/fstab
grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args='rootflags=uquota'
printf '%s\n' '== fstab root =='
findmnt --verify --verbose 2>&1 | tail -20
grep -E '[[:space:]]/[[:space:]]+xfs[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab
printf '%s\n' '== kernel args =='
grubby --info=ALL | grep '^args=' | sort -u
